A Page dedicated to Wiki Editors Sheoix made alot of new Templates and Tables for us to use and this is a quick explanation of all new functions to it. How to add Mounts To add a mount you can simply use Insert > Template and search for Mount. To add a new mount, simple grab its ID from the AA Classic Database and paste it into field called Item ID. As an addition you can also add a custom Mount Speed and the position of the Mount Box by selecting both on the left side of the Template.

In case you should prefer Source editing, just use {{Mount||speed=|float=}}. The follwing example was made using this Source Edit: {{Mount|51188|speed=15.8|float=center}}. Mount Arcane Ser Meatball His royal furriness, anointed knight of toebeans, nemesis of rodents, breaker of tea cups and champion of the litterbox: Ser Meatball. Ser Meatball has the following skills: Lv20: Run!Run!Mana 20Instant30sec CooldownIncreases Mount Move Speed +50% for 10sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv30: Reckless ChargeReckless ChargeInstant30sec CooldownStealths the owner and the mount and charges forward for 3sec, breaking through enemy lines. Inflicts Knockback and Trip on affected enemies. This skill counts as a Push effect. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv40: ShredShredInstant24sec CooldownCharges into a target in the distance, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and an additional (varies) damage over (varies). Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv50: Adore MeAdore MeInstant1min CooldownSer Meatball demands people within a 5m radius to Slow for 4sec and adore his cuteness. Use: Summons a mount. Base Move Speed 15.8m/s You can also put multiple of those next to each other, displaying multiple mounts like this, but it looks weird on mobiles or smaller screens, since one is aligned to the left, one to the right and one to the center. A Page dedicated to Wiki Editors

Sheoix made alot of new Templates and Tables for us to use and this is a quick explanation of all new functions to it.

How to add Mounts

To add a mount you can simply use Insert > Template and search for Mount.

To add a new mount, simple grab its ID from the AA Classic Database and paste it into field called Item ID. As an addition you can also add a custom Mount Speed and the position of the Mount Box by selecting both on the left side of the Template.

In case you should prefer Source editing, just use {{Mount|<MountID>|speed=<Mount Speed>|float=<right/left/center>}}. The follwing example was made using this Source Edit: {{Mount|51188|speed=15.8|float=center}}.

Mount
Arcane
Ser Meatball
His royal furriness, anointed knight of toebeans, nemesis of rodents, breaker of tea cups and champion of the litterbox: Ser Meatball.
Ser Meatball has the following skills:
Lv20: Run!Run!Mana 20Instant30sec CooldownIncreases Mount Move Speed +50% for 10sec.
Can't be used while carrying a trade pack.
Lv30: Reckless ChargeReckless ChargeInstant30sec CooldownStealths the owner and the mount and charges forward for 3sec, breaking through enemy lines.
Inflicts Knockback and Trip on affected enemies.
This skill counts as a Push effect.
Can't be used while carrying a trade pack.
Lv40: ShredShredInstant24sec CooldownCharges into a target in the distance, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and an additional (varies) damage over (varies).
Can't be used while carrying a trade pack.
Lv50: Adore MeAdore MeInstant1min CooldownSer Meatball demands people within a 5m radius to Slow for 4sec and adore his cuteness.
Use:
Summons a mount.
Base Move Speed 15.8m/s

You can also put multiple of those next to each other, displaying multiple mounts like this, but it looks weird on mobiles or smaller screens, since one is aligned to the left, one to the right and one to the center.

How to add Recipe Boxes

To add a recipe box you can simply use Insert > Template and search for RecipeBox.

To add a new recipe, simple grab its ID from the AA Classic Database and paste it into field called Craft ID. As an addition you can also set the position of the Recipe Box by selecting it on the left side of the Template.

In case you should prefer Source editing, just use {{RecipeBox|<RecipeID>|float=<right/left/center>}}. The follwing example was made using this Source Edit: {{RecipeBox|7136|float=center}}.

How to write in Grade Colors

To write in an item grade color such as Mythic, you can simply use Insert > Template and search for Grade.

To choose a color simply select the desired grade in the dropdown and input your text in the box below that.

In case you should prefer Source editing, just use {{Grade|<Grade>|<Text>}}. Here a preview of all Versions with their Source Text.

How to add an Item

To write in an item to your text with a grade to it such as Hay Bale × 50, you can simply use Insert > Template and search for Item.

To choose an item simply select the desired item in the dropdown, select your grade in the dropdown below that and as an extra option, you can choose a quantity for it by selecting the setting in the left side of the template and typing the desired number into the input field. (Currently Only Hay Bales exist, more tba in future).

In case you should prefer Source editing, just use {{Item|<Item Name>|<Grade>|<Quantity>}}. Here a preview of all Versions with their Source Text.
